description: This file implements the input connector component for a system, including classes for managing input devices, event sinks, and a builder for creating input connector instances. It handles various input device types such as touch, keyboard, mouse, switches, and rotary devices, and provides methods to send input events.

classes.name: EventSinkImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the InputConnector::EventSink interface, responsible for sending various input events to devices.

classes.name: InputConnectorImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the InputConnector interface, manages input devices and creates event sinks.

classes.name: InputDevices
classes.description: Struct holding different types of input devices such as touch, keyboard, mouse, switches, and rotary.

classes.name: InputConnectorBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing an InputConnector with specified devices.

methods.name: EventSinkImpl::SendMouseMoveEvent
methods.description: Sends a mouse move event with specified x and y coordinates.

methods.name: EventSinkImpl::SendMouseButtonEvent
methods.description: Sends a mouse button press or release event.

methods.name: EventSinkImpl::SendMouseWheelEvent
methods.description: Sends a mouse wheel scroll event.

methods.name: EventSinkImpl::SendTouchEvent
methods.description: Sends a touch event for a specific device label at given coordinates.

methods.name: EventSinkImpl::SendMultiTouchEvent
methods.description: Sends a multi-touch event for a specific device label with multiple touch slots.

methods.name: EventSinkImpl::SendKeyboardEvent
methods.description: Sends a keyboard key press or release event.

methods.name: InputConnectorImpl::CreateSink
methods.description: Creates a new input event sink.

methods.name: InputConnectorBuilder::WithMultitouchDevice
methods.description: Adds a multitouch device with a specific label and connection.

methods.name: InputConnectorBuilder::WithTouchDevice
methods.description: Adds a touch device with a specific label and connection.

methods.name: InputConnectorBuilder::WithKeyboard
methods.description: Adds a keyboard device with a connection.

methods.name: InputConnectorBuilder::WithSwitches
methods.description: Adds a switches device with a connection.

methods.name: InputConnectorBuilder::WithRotary
methods.description: Adds a rotary device with a connection.

methods.name: InputConnectorBuilder::WithMouse
methods.description: Adds a mouse device with a connection.

methods.name: InputConnectorBuilder::Build
methods.description: Builds and returns the configured InputConnector instance.
